mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best location for a new bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right choice comes down to utility access, layout flow, and project scope. Placing the addition back-to-back with an existing kitchen, laundry room, or existing bathroom significantly shortens plumbing runs and minimizes concrete slab trenching. Hallway conversions provide accessible guest use, whereas building off a bedroom creates a private ensuite. If your interior footprint cannot spare closet or living space, an exterior ground-level bump-out preserves indoor storage while giving you complete freedom to design your ideal layout, walk-in shower, and window placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a spot near existing plumbing lines to reduce trenching costs, or select an exterior wall bump-out if you want to avoid sacrificing interior bedroom or closet space.
